notes.title: 1,001 True Tales of Robin Hood
notes.content:
Huzzah! We've officially sold one-thousand and one copies of Nocked; that's 1,001 true tales of Robin Hood wandering the wide world. Thank you!

If you've played the game, please leave a review and let your fellow Steam community (and myself) know what you think of the game. As always, I'm happy to receive messages and answer questions either through Steam or over e-mail, and I check the forums most days.

Achievements were one of the elements that didn't make the cut in the final version of Nocked; there are so many corner cases and little nuggets to find, and I didn't want to distract from the experience of creating your own story. However, with this milestone, there are a few nuggets I'd like to share with you (with minimal spoilers):
[list]
[*] There are 5 major (and many minor) movie references in the game, from at least 4 different Robin Hood films. Can you find them all? 
[*] Our artist, Amanda Spaid, drew herself into the game as Cook.
[*] There's a hidden fairy you can meet on the forest raids. She's named after my great-grandmother.
[*] The wedding march is the same music (and same fiddler) who played at my own wedding!
[/list]

Additionally exciting, you can now buy the Nocked Soundtrack separately, without owning the game. Give the gift of music, and play on!

Games may be in my future, but for the moment, I'm back to writing novels. A draft of my next book on sky pirates and space mummies is almost complete!

As we look forward to the next 1,001 True Tales of Robin Hood, I want to thank you all again; for playing, for reading, for imagining.

notes.title: Update: The fae guard their gold...
notes.content:
The fair folk play by their own rules - Robin can no longer give gold freely in order to gain renown.

And a couple other typos and image fixes. Thanks to all the merry men and women who've reported bugs or questioned the game design. Keep it coming!
